title: Fix race condition in database field increment
description: Increments the views count for an article.
code:
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import Article

def increment_views(request, article_id):
    article = get_object_or_404(Article, pk=article_id)
    article.views_count = article.views_count + 1
    article.save()
    return HttpResponse('ok')
issue_description: Fetching, modifying, and saving a model instance is not atomic. If two requests execute concurrently, they can read the same count and one update will be lost.
issue_suggestion: Use Django's F() expressions to perform the database update atomically on the database side.

title: Prevent N+1 query explosion during serializer loop
description: Lists all projects and their author names in a API view.
issue_description: Accessing project.author.username for each project executes a separate SQL query per project, causing an N+1 query pattern.
issue_suggestion: Use select_related or prefetch_related to load foreign keys eagerly in a single database query.

title: Prevent database locked/integrity errors in nested atomic blocks
description: Runs user payments updates inside a transaction.
issue_description: If a database error occurs inside a nested atomic block, the transaction is marked as dirty. Swallowing the exception and continuing to use the connection causes a TransactionManagementError.
issue_suggestion: Do not swallow exceptions inside atomic blocks, or use savepoints explicitly and let the parent atomic block roll back correctly.
issue_code: # Let exception propagate or raise custom exception to ensure transaction rollback

title: Fix class-level QuerySet caching in views
description: Displays lists of active promotional offers.
code:
from django.views.generic import ListView
from .models import Promotion

class PromotionListView(ListView):
    # Display list of currently active promotions
    queryset = Promotion.objects.filter(is_active=True)
    template_name = 'promotions.html'
issue_description: Defining the queryset as a class-level attribute caches the results when the server starts. New or modified promotions won't show up without a server restart.
issue_suggestion: Override the get_queryset method to evaluate the query dynamically on each request.

title: Fix session validation bypass in custom middleware
description: Checks if the request is authenticated.
issue_title: Custom auth middleware bypasses user backend validation
issue_description: Trusting 'user_id' in session directly without validating it against the active authentication backends or checking if the user is active bypasses security constraints.
issue_suggestion: Use Django's built-in get_user helper to resolve the user and check user.is_authenticated.
issue_code:
from django.contrib.auth import get_user
request.user = get_user(request)

title: Fix database router bypass using raw connection
description: Fetches analytics data directly from the replica connection.
code:
from django.db import connections

def get_analytics_metrics():
    # Fetch metrics using replica connection directly
    cursor = connections['replica'].cursor()
    cursor.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_events')
    return cursor.fetchone()[0]
issue_title: Hardcoded database alias bypasses multi-db router
issue_description: Bypassing the database router by hardcoding connections['replica'] breaks setups where routers dynamically choose read/write paths or handle failover.
issue_suggestion: Use the Django ORM and specify using() if needed, or rely on a database router to select the proper connection alias.
issue_code:
from django.db import router
db_alias = router.db_for_read(UserEvent)
# Use db_alias dynamically

title: Prevent arbitrary path traversal in custom storage save
description: Saves an uploaded user file to the filesystem.
code:
import os
from django.conf import settings

def save_user_file(file_name, file_content):
    # Save the file to the media directory
    target_path = os.path.join(settings.MEDIA_ROOT, file_name)
    with open(target_path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(file_content)
issue_title: Path traversal via raw filename input
issue_description: Using os.path.join on a raw user-supplied filename allows directory traversal (e.g. '../configs/settings.py') to overwrite files outside MEDIA_ROOT.
issue_suggestion: Use os.path.basename on the filename or Django's get_valid_filename helper to sanitize the filename before joining.

title: Prevent cross-site scripting (XSS) via safe template filter
description: A custom template filter to format user comments.
issue_title: Stored XSS via unsafe mark_safe usage
issue_description: Calling mark_safe on a template filter input containing unescaped user text lets attackers inject malicious HTML/script tags directly into the page.
issue_suggestion: Escape the input string using Django's escape() helper before wrapping it in safe tags.

title: Fix custom form field validation clean method bypass
description: A custom field for validating hex color codes.
issue_title: Form field validation does not run super class validation
issue_description: Overriding validate without calling super().validate(value) bypasses required base validation constraints like max_length or required checks.
issue_suggestion: Always call super().validate(value) in custom form field validation methods.

title: Prevent sync database signals blocking transaction scope
description: Performs external sync operations in a post_save signal.
code:
from django.db.models.signals import post_save
from django.dispatch import receiver
import requests
from .models import Order

@receiver(post_save, sender=Order)
def notify_external_shipping(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    # Make synchronous API call inside the signal handler
    requests.post('https://shipping-api.com/notify', json={'id': instance.id})
issue_title: Blocking synchronous HTTP request inside database signal
issue_description: Making synchronous HTTP calls inside post_save signals blocks the thread executing the database transaction, significantly increasing query durations and pool contention.
issue_suggestion: Offload the external API notification to a background task runner (e.g. Celery or a background thread) or use transaction.on_commit.
issue_code:
from django.db import transaction
transaction.on_commit(lambda: trigger_shipping_task(instance.id))
